title: [SMM Analysis] Ex-China Silicon Steel: Growth Anchored in India, High-End GO and Ultra-Thin Non-Oriented Maintain Tight Balance
dek: SMM analysis says ex-China silicon steel growth is anchored in India, with high-end grain-oriented and ultra-thin non-oriented grades in tight balance.
summary: Shanghai Metals Market published an analysis of the silicon steel market outside China. According to the headline, growth is anchored in India. It adds that high-end grain-oriented and ultra-thin non-oriented grades maintain a tight supply-demand balance. The excerpt gives no figures.
keyFacts: Ex-China silicon steel growth is anchored in India, per SMM
High-end GO and ultra-thin non-oriented silicon steel remain in tight balance
whyItMatters: Electrical steel is a high-value segment tied to power transmission and electric motors. Tightness in premium grades could support pricing and investment.
implications: Indian producers of electrical steel could see sustained demand. Buyers of premium grades may face constrained availability.
